snippets.description: Custom template spatie/laravel-health checks: run(): Result without exceptions outward, try/catch (Throwable), active resource check (disk put/get/delete, heartbeat from cache against threshold, TCP-port via fsockopen), config via config() with defaults, diagnostics in meta, private constructor + static factory forDisk()

config/health.php: result store, notifications (mail/slack, throttle, only_on_failure), json_results_failure_status, secret_token, Oh Dear, project sections (scheduler/service) via env; in the comment - strapping: Health::checks([...]) with factories and built-in checks, routes liveness/readiness/dashboard, schedule health:check + heartbeat scheduler
